hypothesis: Lower-probability NFL teams may win less often than publisher closing consensus probabilities imply, relative to moderate underdogs in the same week, if favorite-longshot distortion remains after consensus de-vigging.
distinction: Probability-calibration diagnostic, not a schedule/rest mechanism, a reversal of failed rules, or a priced betting strategy. Related earlier market-only/calibration families remain disclosed.

source.license: Publisher CC BY4.0 label; upstream rights uncertified. Existing private authorized file only; no new download.
source.benchmark: Consensus proportional de-vig closing home-win probability; not independent bookmaker validation, decision-time information or executable odds.

prior_exposure.season: Entire 2025 NFL season already inspected in rematch and long-rest studies. This reused season is development evidence, never an untouched holdout. No new longshot-group count/outcome/contrast is computed in this registration.
prior_exposure.reason: Preserve previous search-exposed-row exclusions; exclusion does not erase season exposure.

population: 2025 regular season only, weeks 1..18. Exclude postseason. Abort unexpected season/type or invalid required fields.

feature.selected_team: Exactly one lower-probability team per game: home if p_home<1/2, away if p_home>1/2. Equal 1/2 excluded. p_selected=min(p_home,1-p_home).
feature.treated: 0<p_selected<=1/4. This probability boundary corresponds to at least +300 zero-vig fair American odds, not an offered price.
feature.controls: 1/3<=p_selected<1/2. Fair probability boundary corresponds to at most +200 zero-vig fair American odds, not offered prices.
feature.gap: Exclude 1/4<p_selected<1/3; no additional bands, clipping, weighting by odds, source re-estimation or tuned cutoffs.
feature.classification: Use exact decimal/rational comparisons for band boundaries; labels read schedule/identity/probability fields, never scores.

outcomes: Selected-team win indicator minus selected-team publisher closing probability. Validate scores/probabilities for every regular row before exclusions. Tied finals excluded because exact tie pricing/settlement is uncertified. Report nonexclusive search-exposed, tied, even-probability and gap exclusions separately.
primary: For each week with treated and controls, mean treated residual minus mean control residual. Weight weeks by treated count. Sum(n_treated*contrast)/sum(n_treated). Report zero-weight weeks; never substitute another week or global controls.

uncertainty.method: Circular 3-week blocks over full 1..18 grid; six blocks/draw, retain all game contributions per sampled week and recompute weighted primary.
uncertainty.interval: 99% two-sided percentile, linear interpolation at (n-1)*q; report zero-weight skipped draws.

decision: A descriptive calibration lead requires primary<=-0.03 AND upper99%<0. Otherwise not_supported. Gate/minimum failure aborted/insufficient_data. No reverse rule, cutoff rescue, home-away subgroup search or pick/model promotion.
multiplicity: One fixed primary in this diagnostic, all prior 20 registry entries/failures retained. Group win rates/Brier summaries descriptive only. 99% interval does not certify project-wide familywise error control or independent discovery from reused outcomes. Any future confirmation must be separately registered on independent/prospective evidence.
outputs: All exclusion counts and comparable/zero-weight weeks
limits: Probability-band strength/home-away/calendar/source confounding remains. Week bootstrap does not eliminate team dependence. No executable ROI, CLV, causal effect, fees/limits/NY offers, earlier quote or acceptance claim. De-vigged consensus is not an independent fair-value oracle.
next: Implement and test synthetic source/boundary/identity/score-blind labels,selected-team orientation,exclusions,week weighting and deterministic bootstrap; commit and pass hosted checks before actual group evaluation. Preserve protocol bytes unchanged.
